description: Sewer System Lines - City of Newton is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors City of Newton GIS. This data layer line coverage models the sewage collection system network of pipes, mains and aqueducts throughout Newton, Massachusetts. Accompanying point coverage for node features (manholes, pipe intersections, wet wells, pipe ends and pumping stations) can be found in the Sewer System Points - City of Newton datalayer. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational, non-commercial use only.. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
